record.question: The process of coating of iron with zinc to prevent it from rusting is called:
record.explanation: Answer A: Galvanisation. Galvanization coats iron or steel with zinc to inhibit corrosion. Reference: https://galvanizeit.org/knowledgebase/article/what-is-galvanizing. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
